name: Time Lived
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: neptunecentury
description: Keeps tracks of how many days you've survived since your last death and sends you a message after you respawn. You can even add your own custom messages based on how long you live!
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
